# orchestration_cluster_tenant_members (Data Source)

Lists the members of a tenant inside a Camunda cluster, grouped by member type, including members that Terraform does not manage. An empty member list is a valid result; a tenant that does not exist is an error. Clients exist only as members of groups, roles and tenants, so they are listed here and have no data source of their own. See the Camunda documentation on [tenants](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/tenant/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orchestration_cluster_tenant_members" "example" {
  tenant_id = "my-tenant"
}

output "tenant_client_ids" {
  value = data.orchestration_cluster_tenant_members.example.client_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) The ID of the tenant whose members are listed. It must exist.

### Read-Only

- `client_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the clients assigned to the tenant. Empty if there are none.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the groups assigned to the tenant. Empty if there are none.
- `id` (String) The ID of the tenant (the same as `tenant_id`).
- `mapping_rule_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the mapping rules assigned to the tenant. Empty if there are none.
- `role_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the roles assigned to the tenant. Empty if there are none.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) The IDs of the users assigned to the tenant. Empty if there are none.
